metaDescription: Plan projects, bring your team together and track tasks and sprints with PDA. A project delivery assistant for students and small teams.
description: A shared workspace for your next project. Set clear goals, share the work and follow the path to delivery together.
overviewAlt: PDA project overview showing criteria progress, team information and completion trends.
criteriaAlt: PDA success criteria screen showing completed and ongoing criteria.
previewCaption: The real PDA interface, shown with sample project data in Turkish.
featuresTitle: Every part of your project, together.
featuresDescription: See who is doing what and what comes next without switching between tools.
projectsTitle: Give your goals a shared home.
projectsDescription: Keep the purpose, dates and success criteria of your project in one place. See how your work is progressing.
teamDescription: Create teams, invite collaborators and define project roles. Build a clear structure for working together.
workDescription: Break work into tasks, assign owners and plan sprints. Follow work on the board and dates on your calendar.
stepsDescription: Three small steps to a shared workspace.
accountDescription: Sign up and enter your workspace.
projectDescription: Set your project goal and success criteria.
inviteDescription: Create teams, invite collaborators and share the tasks.
closingTitle: Make room for your next idea.
closingDescription: Work towards the same goal from the same workspace.
